mode.nerocompanion.carry.tip: Picks up dropped items nearby (including ones you toss) and puts them in the container you bound with the Remote (sneak-use it).
mode.nerocompanion.follow.tip: Stays close and comes along wherever you go.
mode.nerocompanion.guard.tip: Watches over you and fights hostile mobs that come near. Never players unless the server allows it.
mode.nerocompanion.mine.tip: Digs out the area you mark with the Remote (sneak-use two corners). Leaves anything protected alone.
mode.nerocompanion.repair.tip: Mends the damaged tools and armour you carry, using its own power.
mode.nerocompanion.scout.tip: Flies ahead, lights up ore and enemies for you, and warns you of danger behind you.
mode.nerocompanion.sleep.tip: Powers down and stops using energy. Pick any job to wake it.
mode.nerocompanion.stay.tip: Waits right where it is until you say otherwise.
quest.nerocompanion.companion_log.bluepr: Craft your first companion Capsule. A Helper Drone Capsule is the simplest place to start.
quest.nerocompanion.companion_log.bond_t: Work, play and spend time with one companion until your bond reaches level 3.
quest.nerocompanion.companion_log.compan: Deploy, upgrade, adopt and fill out a squad. Finishing all four earns the Aurora cosmetic skin for your companions.
quest.nerocompanion.companion_log.first_: Bind a container with the Remote and let a carrier deliver its cargo there.
Charge one of your companions on a Charging Pad, in a Companion Bay or with the Hand Crank Charger.
Insert an upgrade chip into one of your companions.
Deploy a companion from its item so it binds to you as its owner.
Set a Combat Bot to guard and let it see off a hostile mob.
Keep a Scrap Egg warm on a Charging Pad or in a Companion Bay until a Scrapling hatches.
Mark an area with the Remote and let a Mining Bot dig it out.
Reclaim a lost companion from a Companion Bay.
Let a Repair Bot mend a worn tool or piece of gear for you.
quest.nerocompanion.companion_log.full_s: Have as many companions active at once as this server allows.
quest.nerocompanion.companion_log.pet_ad: Hatch a Scrapling from a Scrap Egg, or tame a pet creature, so it follows you as one of your own.
skin.nerocompanion.mining_bot.hazard.unl: Use a Hazard Decal on it here — press Apply while you have one.
